cues.text_en: Hi! Let's count triangular numbers, and watch a little triangle turn into a working number pattern.
cues.visual: title / warm greeting

cues.text_en: The small letter n tells us how many rows to use. The big answer tells us how many dots belong to one triangle.
cues.visual: n is a row count, T_n is a total

cues.text_en: Make two matching triangles, fit them into a rectangle, then choose one of the two equal groups. Watch the formula move!
cues.visual: preview the operations, no final endpoint value
